paragraphs: AI cooking and meal-planning assistant. Tell it what is in your kitchen, your diet, allergies and nutrition targets; it finds recipes with hybrid RAG search, plans your week with a LangGraph agent, builds a grocery list from what is missing and answers cooking questions in a chat. You can add your own recipes from photos, a link or by typing them in, and cook any recipe in cooking mode. The model proposes; deterministic code decides. Every recipe and plan is re-checked against your allergens and diet before you see it.

Live demo: ("Try it as a guest" needs no account. The API runs on Render's free plan and sleeps when idle, so the first request can take about 50 seconds.) Demo video walkthrough: docs/demo-script.md.
